ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The trip was driven 14.31 km according to the platform's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02848) against a booked optimal route of 2.4 km (EV-TRIP-02848). The excess is 11.91 km, or 496.25% of optimal, so the POL-RD-01 deviation is established and is additionally MATERIAL, being over both 8.0 km and 50%. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 130 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so the excess is measured from the trace itself and no independent corroboration is needed. To the driver: your explanation that the rider changed the destination verbally is not supported by any evidence. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02848) contains zero messages, so there is no rider instruction of the kind POL-RD-04(a) to (c) requires and no waypoint_hint to test, and the trip record shows the pickup and dropoff were never amended, so POL-RD-05 cannot apply either. No traffic advisory was on file (EV-ADVIS-02848-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), and an assertion citing no evidence ID carries no weight under POL-RD-08. To the rider: the refund is the arithmetic of POL-RD-02 on the METERED fare (EV-FARE-02848). Charged total: 21.35. Recomputed fare: (3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x 1.0 surge from the fare breakdown + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 7.80. Refund: 21.35 - 7.80 = 13.55, which is 63.5% of the charge - above the 0.50 de minimis, below the 90% that would make it a full refund. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry, toll or airport surcharge line, so there is nothing to correct or add under POL-RD-09. The driver's profile shows no repeat deviation pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 of 210 completed trips in 90 days), so no POL-RD-06 full-refund uplift and no driver-conduct referral arise on this trip. Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 13.55 to the rider; no driver compensation, because the distance billed (14.3 km) is not more than 1.0 km short of the trace distance (14.31 km). This refund exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it issues now and is held for release by a reviewer rather than executed automatically. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
